== Ranger Stories ==
These chapters were published exclusively for the [[Pokémon Daisuki Club]], with the first five being based on the W mission of [[Pokémon Ranger (video game)|Pokémon Ranger]], and the latter four being based on [[Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia]] as a whole. Worked on by the duo of [[Hidenori Kusaka|Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto|Yamamoto]], [[Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission]] is referenced in [[PS441|The Final Dimensional Duel XI]] and its first chapter was included in [[The Art of Pokémon Adventures|The Art of Pokémon Adventures.]]
